create_CustomBusinessHour_offset: create a CustomBusinessHour offset with custom start and end business hours

create_CustomBusinessHour_with_weekmask: create a CustomBusinessHour offset with a custom weekmask for selected working days
test_CustomBusinessHour_rollback: test the CustomBusinessHour rollback method to find the last valid business hour
test_CustomBusinessHour_rollforward: test the CustomBusinessHour rollforward method to find the next valid business hour
test_CustomBusinessHour_is_on_offset: test whether a datetime falls within the CustomBusinessHour on-offset range
test_CustomBusinessHour_apply: test the CustomBusinessHour _apply method to advance a datetime by business hours
test_CustomBusinessHour_normalize: test the CustomBusinessHour normalize mode to snap datetimes to business day boundaries
test_CustomBusinessHour_with_nano: test the CustomBusinessHour offset with Nano nanosecond precision additions
test_CustomBusinessHour_with_calendar: test the CustomBusinessHour offset using USFederalHolidayCalendar for holiday exclusions
